metadata.question: Did the Alisal Fire cover less than 10,000 acres from October 11, 2021 to October 13, 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS 1 km daily fire mask (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1) over a 30 km buffer centered on the Alisal Fire (lon -120.11, lat 34.53), date range 2021-10-11 to 2021-10-14 (end-exclusive to cover Oct 11-13). If empty, fallback to MODIS daily fire mask (MODIS/061/MOD14A1).
2. Masking strategy: Not cloud-masking; we detect fire pixels where FireMask >= 7 (low/nominal/high confidence). We union fire detections across days (max) to avoid double-counting.
3. Valid Zero vs Null: Count total valid pixels in ROI at 1 km. If 0 -> C2. If area result is null/NaN/invalid -> C3. Otherwise, compare acres to 10,000 for A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roiCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.11, 34.53]);
    const roi = roiCenter.buffer(30000); // 30 km buffer
    const start = '2021-10-11';
    const end = '2021-10-14'; // end-exclusive covers Oct 11-13
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 2e9;
    const acresPerM2 = 0.00024710538146717;
    const thresholdAcres = 10000;

    function analyzeCollection(colId) {
      const col = ee.ImageCollection(colId)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(roi);
      const countImages = col.size();
      const fireUnion = col.select('FireMask')
        .map(function(img) {
          // FireMask: 7=low, 8=nominal, 9=high confidence fire
          return img.select('FireMask').gte(7).rename('Fire');
        })
        .max()
        .rename('Fire'); // 0/1 union of fire presence
      const fireMasked = fireUnion.updateMask(fireUnion); // mask to count only fire pixels

      // Count of all 1km pixels in ROI (valid grid cells)
      const ones = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('ones');
      const validCount = ones.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('ones');

      // Count of union fire pixels and area
      const fireCount = fireMasked.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('Fire');

      const fireAreaM2 = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(fireUnion).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('area'); // 'area' will be null; we should use get from dictionary key; pixelArea band name is 'area'
      // Correction: pixelArea band is named 'area', but when updating mask from another image, the band name remains 'area'.

      return {
        col: col,
        countImages: countImages,
        validCount: validCount,
        fireCount: fireCount,
        fireAreaM2: fireAreaM2
      };
    }

    // Helper to safely getInfo with default
    async function getInfoSafe(obj) {
      try {
        return await obj.getInfo();
      } catch (e) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let primaryId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1';
    let altId = 'MODIS/061/MOD14A1';
    let res = analyzeCollection(primaryId);
    let nImages = await getInfoSafe(res.countImages);
    let usedId = primaryId;

    if (!nImages || nImages === 0) {
      // Fallback
      res = analyzeCollection(altId);
      nImages = await getInfoSafe(res.countImages);
      usedId = altId;
    }

    if (!nImages || nImages === 0) {
      console.log(`Date window: ${start} to ${end}`);
      console.log(`ROI center [-120.11, 34.53], buffer_km: 30`);
      console.log(`Images found: 0 (both primary and fallback)`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: compute counts and area
    const validCount = await getInfoSafe(res.validCount);
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Date window: ${start} to ${end}`);
      console.log(`Dataset used: ${usedId}`);
      console.log(`Images: ${nImages}`);
      console.log(`Valid pixels after processing: 0`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const fireCount = await getInfoSafe(res.fireCount) || 0;
    let fireAreaM2 = await getInfoSafe(res.fireAreaM2);
    // If fireAreaM2 is null (no fire), set to 0
    if (fireAreaM2 === null || fireAreaM2 === undefined) {
      fireAreaM2 = 0;
    }
    const fireAreaAcres = fireAreaM2 * acresPerM2;

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = !isFinite(fireAreaAcres) || fireAreaAcres < 0;
    console.log(`Date window: ${start} to ${end}`);
    console.log(`ROI center [-120.11, 34.53], buffer_km: 30`);
    console.log(`Dataset used: ${usedId}`);
    console.log(`Images: ${nImages}`);
    console.log(`Valid 1km pixels in ROI: ${validCount}`);
    console.log(`Fire pixels (union across days): ${fireCount}`);
    console.log(`Estimated fire area (acres): ${fireAreaAcres.toFixed(0)}`);
    console.log(`Decision threshold (acres): ${thresholdAcres}`);

    if (invalid) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    if (fireAreaAcres < thresholdAcres) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
